independence: replayed by the validator (not the producer) with the pinned binaries; nonce drawn by the validator from /dev/urandom after the snapshot commit; comparison code written by the validator
scalar_check_used: Not independently verified. The pinned jv_cover prints and writes neither the solved logarithm nor the instance (alpha, G, Q, l). The check used is the binary's own: after the linear algebra it tests dd*G == Q on E(F_{p^6}) (EllE::mul) and sets correct = (dd == planted d) (src/cryptanalysis/jv_cover.rs, run_cover_dlp, at the run commit). The replay reproduced solved=true and correct=true, and all four same-process rho runs correct=true, with every deterministic counter equal to the recorded row.
